name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Strategy & Growth Leader | Founder-Level Brand, Demand Generation & Business Development Ownership
summary: Marketing leader who has personally owned the full function, strategy, brand, demand generation, budget, and execution, for his own company since 2024, after 15+ years in growth and account roles building the skill set that supports it. Not a corporate CMO title, but the kind of ownership a pre-seed company's first marketing hire actually needs: someone who builds the function from nothing rather than manages an existing department. Combines hands-on demand generation and data-driven decision-making with genuine differentiation in AI-driven marketing systems.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Develop and execute full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, demonstrating clear ROI and revenue growth.
Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for service-based businesses, automating lead enrichment, outreach, and appointment booking.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Draft clean, specific, ethically aligned direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, acting as strategic lead and coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.
